decisions.reason: Premium support is close to the firm's core promise of round-the-clock expert service and costs little to keep, so dropping it would contradict the agency-focused positioning the firm has announced.
The version manager builds on the firm's own tool development, has its own page and was highlighted as a current innovation, so writing off that development investment would be hard to justify.

The data processing contract tool is distant from the core business and the firm has not tied it to its announced direction, but it was developed as a product line with several models and has its own page, and its running costs are likely low.

Scalable agency hosting is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's direction and is backed by heavy platform investment, so management would persist with it and attribute any weak results to temporary causes.
